items.description: A new warning-level alert fires when a node's memory stall rate is above 0.02 while MemAvailable is above 25% of MemTotal and major faults average under 50/s over an hour, held for at least an hour. Once firing it keeps firing through that node's memory dips and fault bursts for as long as the stall rate stays above 0.02, and resolves when the counter stops (a reboot). Its message names the node and says the stall alerts on that node are blind until it is rebooted.
items.rationale: Static: configs/prd/prometheus/prd/values.yaml:133-160 — NodeMemoryStallCounterWedged's expression and `for: 1h` match the criterion's qualifying condition, hold and message exactly; P1's Record documents promtool witness scenarios for the hold-through-dips and reboot-resolves behaviour (not re-derived here). Live, post-deploy: prometheus.home /api/v1/query for ALERTS{alertname="NodeMemoryStallCounterWedged"} returns node=srvk8s1, alertstate=pending — exactly the node close-out A1 already flagged as wedged since 2026-09-16, correctly qualifying and on track to cross into firing within the hour (the `for: 1h` clock restarted with this deploy's fresh rule group), and no other node's series present (correctly quiet elsewhere).

items.area: D2 — stall alerts inhibited on a wedged node
items.description: While the wedge warning fires for a node, Alertmanager inhibits that node's NodeMemoryStalled and NodeMemoryStallElevated, so neither is delivered from a wedged node, including through a memory dip or fault burst on that node long enough to meet the stall alert's for-window; stall alerts on other nodes and every other alert are not inhibited. The inhibition matches on the node label, which every production series of node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total carries (Prometheus series API, 2026-09-14).
items.rationale: Live, post-deploy: amtool config show confirms the running Alertmanager config carries exactly one inhibit rule — source alertname="NodeMemoryStallCounterWedged", target alertname=~"NodeMemoryStalled|NodeMemoryStallElevated", equal: [node] — matching the criterion verbatim, and no other inhibit rule exists (so other alerts are correctly untouched). Not live-exercised end-to-end this pass: srvk8s1's wedge warning is still `pending` (V05), not yet `firing`, so there is no live inhibition event to observe right now (Alertmanager's own `amtool alert` list is empty). This exact mechanism was witnessed by code-writer in P2 (local Alertmanager 0.34.1 against fake data: srvk8s1's two stall alerts suppressed under its wedge warning while srvk8s1's NodeKubeReservedMissing and srvk8s2's stall alert stayed active) — combined with the live confirmation that the identical rule is the one actually running in production, this is verified rather than merely configured.
evidence: live: kubectl -n prometheus-prd exec prometheus-prd-alertmanager-0 -- amtool config show — inhibit_rules: exactly one rule, source NodeMemoryStallCounterWedged / target NodeMemoryStalled|NodeMemoryStallElevated / equal [node]
